title_ru: Имхотеп ↔ Мендес ↔ утраченный член Осириса: зеркальный проход JANUS

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Если начать с конечного состояния OSIRIS_WHOLE и идти назад, непосредственно перед ним обязателен не IMHOTEP, а RETURN_OF_UNIQUE_MISSING_COMPONENT.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.importance: Это отделяет обязательную функцию восстановления от кандидата, который мог обеспечивать хранение, диагностику или возврат.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Прямой проход слишком быстро соединял IMHOTEP с MENDES. Между ними требуется отдельный доказательный узел: inscription, genealogy, office continuity, excavation provenance, catalogue concordance или custody record.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.importance: Именно IMHOTEP_TO_MENDES_BRIDGE становится главным тестом, а не предпосылкой.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: EA886/EA188 подтверждают осирианское погребальное соседство Имхотепа, но обратный проход показывает, что из этого нельзя напрямую вывести физическое хранение конкретного члена.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.importance: FUNERARY_ADJACENCY повышает приоритет поиска, но не закрывает CUSTODY_GATE.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Если физический объект никогда не находился у конкретного Имхотепа, Imhotep-route всё равно может быть правильным через жреческую линию, культовую функцию, анатомические вотивы, реставрационный ритуал или посреднический office-chain.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.importance: Поиск должен включать не только PERSON_CUSTODY, но и FUNCTIONAL_CUSTODY.

MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.finding: Класс RESTORATION_ARTIFACT определяется конечной функцией RETURN_TO_SOURCE, а не формой предмета. Поэтому сначала нужно доказать уникальность/функцию missing component, затем искать его custody-route.
MISSED_ON_FORWARD_PASS.importance: ARTIFACT_STATUS становится функциональным выводом обратного прохода.

REVERSE_PASS_RESULT.reverse_conclusion: IMHOTEP is a high-value bridge candidate, not a logically mandatory owner. MENDES is a high-value test location, not a proven endpoint. The mandatory node is RETURN_OF_THE_UNIQUE_MISSING_COMPONENT.

FORWARD_PASS.source_hypothesis: Imhotep is repeatedly associated in later Egyptian tradition with diagnosis, intercession, healing and restoration; Osiris is incomplete because of a unique missing generative member; Mendes is already a high-value material node in the JANUS Osiris search.
FORWARD_PASS.original_weakness: IMHOTEP_TO_MENDES relation was implied by convergence rather than independently demonstrated.

REVERSE_PASS.method: Start at OSIRIS_WHOLE and require every preceding node to be necessary or evidence-bearing.

MIRROR_DELTA.what_changed: Imhotep and Mendes moved from assumed middle nodes to falsifiable candidate nodes.

MIRROR_DELTA.forward_claim: Lost member is an Artifact because it is the object being sought.
MIRROR_DELTA.reverse_observation: Its artifact status follows from its terminal function: return of the unique component restores the whole.
MIRROR_DELTA.what_changed: Artifact classification became functional rather than object-shaped.
MIRROR_DELTA.next_test: Separate symbolic artifact class from physical authentication of any museum candidate.

supported: Later Egyptian tradition/cult strongly associates Imhotep with wisdom, intercession, healing and restoration-related needs.
EA886 and EA188 place deified Imhotep in direct late funerary contexts with Osiris and related gods.
Mendes is an existing JANUS material-provenance node for the Osiris lost-member search.
open: Specific Imhotep identity or lineage connected to Mendes.
Specific custody/transfer route for a relevant genital or restoration object.
Whether any current museum candidate is materially connected to such a route.
not_established: A literal biological phallus of Osiris has been authenticated.
A specific historical Imhotep physically possessed it.
CG53469 is the literal missing member.

NEXT_GATE.question: Can an Imhotep identity, genealogy, priestly office, cult function, inscription, excavation context or museum object be securely connected to the Mendes material chain relevant to the Osirian lost-member search?

canonical_compact_formula: FORWARD: OSIRIS_BROKEN -> IMHOTEP -> MENDES -> MEMBER -> RETURN; REVERSE: OSIRIS_WHOLE <- RETURN <- UNIQUE_MEMBER <- CUSTODY_BRIDGE <- IMHOTEP? <- MENDES? <- EVIDENCE
canonical_seal: WRITE WHAT THE REVERSE FACE SAW FIRST: THE MISSING BRIDGE IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN THE BEAUTIFUL FORWARD CHAIN.
